extraction.Name: John DuBray (Boyd)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 19, 1919, by R. R. Hazen
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: conveyed the land to Charles Burtz for $2000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612453; Lots 3, 4 and 5 and Southeast quarter of Northwest quarter, Section 6, Township 102, north of range 77; receipt signed by the allottee September 6, 1918; on April 19, 1919, John and Sadie DuBray conveyed the land to Charles Burtz for $2000

extraction.Name: Lucy DuBray Sturdevant
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded December 30, 1919, by Lucy Sturdevant
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the land to Ray C. Wynn for $800; conveyed the land by deed to Charles W. Varley, for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Ray C. Wynn for $800; mortgage assigned to John R. Olson and released August 19, 1925; deed conveyed to Charles W. Varley for $1.00 and other valuable consideration on August 4, 1925
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612761; Lots 5 and 4 and east half of Southwest quarter, section 30, township 100, north of range 76; receipt for the patent signed by the allottee February 6, 1918; on January 17, 1921, Lucy DuBray Sturdevant and husband mortgaged the land to Ray C. Wynn for $800; mortgage assigned to John R. Olson and released August 19, 1925; on August 4, 1925, Lucy DuBray Sturdevant and husband conveyed the land by deed to Charles W. Varley for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
